scenes.name: problem
scenes.caption: USB phones and local gateways expose different permissions. OpenBridge makes their facts, sources and limits visible.

scenes.name: real-android
scenes.caption: A real, authorized USB phone. These facts are read from Android; private device identifiers stay hidden.

scenes.name: recorded-meta
scenes.caption: Meta Muse Spark 1.3: a real recorded runtime-core inference on synthetic facts. Viewing this proof makes no new API call.

scenes.name: meta-boundaries
scenes.caption: The model result carries evidence references and uncertainty. Physical device data stays local; default cloud requests are blocked.

scenes.name: simulated-change
scenes.caption: SIMULATED recovery sandbox: save the exact original value, apply a bounded change, then verify the read-back. No phone setting changes here.

scenes.name: durable-recovery
scenes.caption: After a page reload, the saved transaction still exists. The original value has not been lost.

scenes.name: simulated-undo
scenes.caption: SIMULATED Undo restores the exact saved value. This demonstrates durable recovery, not physical-device rollback.

scenes.name: real-gateway
scenes.caption: A second real protocol: Freebox public identity discovery. No pairing, credentials or router configuration is used.

scenes.name: real-refusal-record
scenes.caption: RECORDED PHYSICAL ATTEMPT: Android refused the write. A separate read confirmed the original setting remained intact. Physical Undo success is not claimed.

scenes.name: validation
scenes.caption: 71 unit/integration tests. Green Windows, Linux and offline-browser CI. Event-created source and sanitized evidence are public on GitHub.

scenes.name: closing
scenes.caption: OpenBridge · github.com/toskaman/openbridge. Read-only physical devices. Verified simulated recovery. Meta Muse Spark 1.3 design and runtime evidence.

limitations: Meta proof is recorded, not a live browser/provider request.
The actual physical write was refused; original state was preserved.
Only one authorized physical USB phone was available.
